test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for ₹19.5, a dealer makes a profit of 25%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹) so as to make a profit of 50%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = ₹19.5

Profit percentage (P%) = 25%

New profit percentage = 50%

**Formula used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit% / 100)

New Selling Price (New SP) = CP × (1 + New Profit% / 100)
